{'source': 'Apple has just released iPadOS 26, its next major software update for iPad users. Here are the new features.', 'translation': 'Apple 剛推出 iPadOS 26，呢個係專為 iPad 用戶而設嘅下一個重大軟件更新。以下係新功能介紹。'}

{'source': 'iPadOS 26 arrives with Apple Intelligence, new app features, upgraded parental controls, and more', 'translation': 'iPadOS 26 正式登場，帶嚟 Apple Intelligence、新嘅應用程式功能、升級嘅家長控制以及其他多項改進'}

{'source': 'iPad users, Apple has just released iPadOS 26, their next major software update. Users can go to Settings → General → Software Update to install.', 'translation': 'iPad 用戶注意，Apple 剛發佈咗 iPadOS 26，亦即係佢哋嘅下一個重大軟件更新。用戶可以前往「設定」→「一般」→「軟件更新」安裝更新。'}

{'source': 'The supported iPad models have been listed here, and there are five models that can run iPadOS 25 that are being cut. These include the iPad Pro 12.9-inch (3rd generation), iPad Pro 11-inch (1st generation), iPad (8th generation), iPad mini 5, and iPad Air 3.', 'translation': '支援更新嘅 iPad 型號已喺呢度列出，共有五款可以運行 iPadOS 25 嘅型號被淘汰。不再獲支援嘅包括 iPad Pro 12.9 吋（第 3 代）、iPad Pro 11 吋（第 1 代）、iPad（第 8 代）、iPad mini 5 以及 iPad Air 3。'}

{'source': 'Headlining iPadOS 26 is Apple Intelligence, which is a major upgrade to the assistant that makes it smarter and more personal than ever. Users can invoke Apple Intelligence via a dedicated Siri app, a swipe down from the screen, or previously supported methods like “Hey Siri” or hold of the side button.', 'translation': 'Apple 喺 iPadOS 26 嘅重頭戲係 Apple Intelligence，呢個係對呢個智能助理嘅一次重大升級，佢比以往更聰明、更個人化。用戶可以透過專屬嘅 Siri 應用程式、從屏幕向下掃，或者用之前支援嘅方式，例如「喂 Siri」或者按住側鍵嚟啟動 Apple Intelligence。'}

{'source': 'Spotlight search is integrated with Siri, which is one of my favorite changes this year.', 'translation': 'Spotlight 搜尋已經同 Siri 整合，呢個係我今年最鍾意嘅改動之一。'}

{'source': 'iPadOS 26 makes iPad feel more like a Mac with updates like adding the app name to the status bar, and the ability to keep the menu bar permanently visible.', 'translation': 'iPadOS 26 嘅多項更新令 iPad 用起上嚟更似 Mac，例如喺狀態欄加入應用程式名稱，以及可以將選單欄設定為永久顯示。'}

{'source': 'System apps are getting in on the iPadOS 26 fun with lots of new capabilities. You can check out what’s new in Messages, Notes, Photos, Calendar, Mail, Reminders, Maps, Safari, and Apple Music at the links below.', 'translation': '系統應用程式亦受惠於 iPadOS 26 嘅大量新功能。你可以透過以下連結了解「訊息」、「備忘錄」、「相片」、「日曆」、「郵件」、「提醒事項」、「地圖」、「Safari」以及 Apple Music 嘅新功能詳情。'}

{'source': 'Apple is also bringing a collection of upgraded Screen Time features and other parental controls to iPadOS 26. The update also comes with a variety of system improvements and bug fixes that should make your iPad run smoother than ever.', 'translation': 'Apple 仲喺 iPadOS 26 帶嚟一系列升級嘅「屏幕使用時間」功能以及其他家長控制工具。呢次更新亦包含多項系統改進同錯誤修復，應該可以令你部 iPad 運行得前所未有地順暢。'}

{'source': 'For more on iPadOS 26, you can read our full coverage here.', 'translation': '想了解更多關於 iPadOS 26 嘅資訊，可以睇我哋喺呢度嘅完整報道。'}

{'source': 'What is your favorite new feature in iPadOS 26? Let us know in the comments.', 'translation': '你最鍾意 iPadOS 26 嘅邊一項新功能？歡迎喺留言區告訴我哋。'}
